column1: AP Calculus BC,4.6,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-h-4.6-b,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-h-4.6-b,R3,R3/R3,,"Multi-step: compute tangent line estimate, then interpret concavity's effect on actual time, demanding conceptual reasoning.
column2: Requires tangent-line approximation with a time shift plus concave-up reasoning: the line underestimates T, so 200°F is reached later.","A pie is removed from an oven at t = 10 minutes. Its temperature T(t), in degrees Fahrenheit, satisfies T(10) = 250 and T′(10) = −4, and T is concave up for t ≥ 10. The tangent line at t = 10 is used to estimate when the pie reaches 200 degrees Fahrenheit. Which statement is correct?"

column1: AP Calculus BC,4.6,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-sv-h-4.6-b-v1,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-h-4.6-b,R3,R3/R3,,"Requires multi-step reasoning: compute tangent line estimate, interpret concavity's effect on tangent line approximation, and apply context of decreasing volume.
column2: Requires building the tangent line, solving for time, then using concavity to argue the actual draining time is longer.","A tank is draining. At t = 5 minutes the volume is V(5) = 900 liters, and V′(5) = −30 liters per minute. V is concave up for t ≥ 5. The tangent line at t = 5 is used to estimate when the volume reaches 600 liters. Which statement is correct?"

column1: AP Calculus BC,4.6,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-sv-h-4.6-b-v2,apcalcbc-mcq-b4-h-4.6-b,R3,R3/R3,,"Requires computing a tangent line estimate, interpreting concavity's impact on approximation error, and deducing time shift (multi-step reasoning).
column2: Requires constructing the tangent line, solving for time, and interpreting concave-down overestimation to determine actual crossing occurs later.","A town's population is P(t) thousand people, t years after 2000. P(2) = 40 and P′(2) = 6, and P is concave down for t ≥ 2. The tangent line at t = 2 is used to estimate when the population reaches 70 thousand. Which statement is correct?"

column2: Requires constructing and solving the tangent-line equation, then interpreting concavity to compare actual and estimated crossing times.","A company's yearly revenue is R(t) million dollars, t years after launch.
